test_title: PYST 50: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

O. delicious

R. she

Q. a

P. baked

S. chocolate cake
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence correctly begins with the subject **"she"**, indicated by **part (R)**. (उसने)
 
• Following the subject, **"baked"** **(P)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what she did. (पकाया)
 
• **Next, "a delicious chocolate cake"**, completes the object of the verb, indicated by **(QOS**). (एक चॉकलेट केक)

Therefore, the correct answer is **RPQOS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (QOSRP):** This sequence starts with the object "a chocolate cake" which does not make sense as the subject should start the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (OPQRS):** This sequence starts with an adjective "delicious", which leaves the sentence fragment and incomplete.
 
• **Option 4 (SRPQO):** This sequence starts with the verb "chocolate cake" that is separated from its subject, leading to an incorrect and confusing structure.
